To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The use of a context-aware neural model improves the extraction of temporal information, (2) The use of the temporal information in a temporal relation extraction model improves the extraction accuracy, (3) The temporal relations are more accurately extracted when the context-aware model is used, and (4) The use of both the context-aware model and the temporal information in the temporal relation extraction model leads to an improvement in the extraction accuracy.
the use of a context-aware neural model is beneficial for temporal information extraction and the use of syntactic dependencies between entities is useful for event-timex and event-event pairs.

(1) the temporal information extraction task is an important and challenging problem in NLP, (2) the state-of-the-art models in temporal information extraction have not been evaluated on a standard benchmark dataset, (3) we propose a novel neural network model for temporal information extraction and show that our model outperforms all existing approaches, (4) we release the TIE dataset, which contains temporal relations for a variety of event types
In summary, our research is concerned with
temporal relations in text
the development of an efficient, accurate and robust system for temporal relation extraction.
the development of a context-aware neural model for temporal information extraction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the context-aware neural model for temporal information extraction is a state-of-the-art model for temporal information.
the context-aware neural model is a better model than the baseline model.
the context-aware neural network model outperformed the baseline model by 2.4% on the ACE05 corpus, which was a significant improvement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a novel approach that combines the strengths of neural models with the rich context information from the input text.
the proposed model is able to capture the context of the event, and the temporal information, and is able to learn from it.
it is an extension of the previous work by [3] in which we have used a more complex neural network model to capture the context of temporal relations and their features.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the context-aware neural model can learn the temporal relation between two time expressions from a small set of features, which are not sufficient for a traditional machine learning model.
context matters in temporal information extraction and the context-aware model outperforms a baseline that does not use context.

the use of a neural model can significantly outperform the best existing rule-based models for temporal relation extraction, and that the performance of a neural model is further boosted when it is combined with a rich set of features.
